mapper.sql: id, model_code AS modelCode, display_name AS displayName, description, model_type AS modelType, implementation_type AS implementationType, implementation_key AS implementationKey, config_schema::text AS configSchema, default_config::text AS defaultConfig, is_user_defined AS isUserDefined, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quant_model_definition WHERE (#{includeInactive} = TRUE OR is_active = TRUE) ORDER BY is_active DESC, is_user_defined ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_model_definition ( model_code, display_name, description, model_type, implementation_type, implementation_key, config_schema, default_config, is_user_defined, is_active, created_by ) VALUES ( #{modelCode}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{modelType}, #{implementationType}, #{implementationKey}, #{configSchema}::jsonb, #{defaultConfig}::jsonb, #{isUserDefined}, #{isActive}, #{createdBy} ) ON CONFLICT (model_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_model_definition SET display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, model_type = #{modelType}, implementation_type = #{implementationType}, implementation_key = #{implementationKey}, config_schema = #{configSchema}::jsonb, default_config = #{defaultConfig}::jsonb, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE quant_model_definition SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
